description: Disabled-node semantics. Traces the n8n 2.9.4 reference by hand, line by line: getHighestNode (workflow.ts:487-565, strict '=== false' at :498 for the starting node, lenient '!== true' at :553 for parents) and getStartNode/__getStartNode (workflow.ts:816-867, '!node.disabled' at :824, 'disabled === true' skips at :839/:853). Plain traversal (getParentNodes/getChildNodes) has NO disabled branch in the reference (graph-utils.ts) and must stay disabled-blind.

probes.name: D-01 highest of C is transparent through disabled B
D-02 highest of Y is empty: disabled leaf parent X is excluded (workflow.ts:553)
D-04a highest of E (explicit disabled:false) is itself (workflow.ts:498)
D-04b highest of F (explicit disabled:true) is nothing (workflow.ts:498)
D-04c highest of Trigger (omitted flag) is NOT itself — strict === false (workflow.ts:498)
D-01b highest of A via recursion through no disabled nodes
D-03a start node of D is the single non-disabled highest candidate (workflow.ts:824)
D-03b start node of Y: highest is empty, destination is the single candidate (workflow.ts:821-825)
D-03c start node of F skips the disabled single candidate and scans STARTING_NODE_TYPES (workflow.ts:839/:853)
scope: parents of C INCLUDE disabled B — plain traversal is disabled-blind
scope: children of A INCLUDE disabled B — plain traversal is disabled-blind
